distribution.narrative: Yin et al. (1984) report a Shanxi record with a county locality transcribed here as Jiangxian, under the published name Scolytus shikisani. The county name's source-character spelling has not been independently resolved; no modern administrative equivalence is asserted. Huang & Lu (2015) retain Shanxi under the same historical name without county-level detail. These are literature-based records, and the regional occurrence assessment remains Candidate. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Henan as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.

host_note: Host names reported by cited sources, not independently confirmed. The regional occurrence assessment is not changed. Source name spelled Scolytus shikisani; retained verbatim for nomenclatural provenance.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytus chikisanii Niisima, 1905.
